name: 911 Carrera
tagline: The benchmark, refined for six decades.
description: The 992.2-generation 911 Carrera keeps the rear-mounted flat-six and the silhouette that has defined the sports car since 1963, now with a sharper twin-turbo 3.0-litre engine and a fully digital cockpit.

name: 458 Spider
tagline: Maranello's naturally aspirated V8, roof down.
description: Designed by Pininfarina and powered by a 9,000 rpm 4.5-litre V8, the 458 is widely considered one of the greatest mid-engined Ferraris ever built. The Spider adds a folding aluminium hard-top that stows in 14 seconds. This is a fully detailed, real-scale 3D model including its cabin.

name: Huracán EVO
tagline: A naturally aspirated V10 with a wedge-shaped soul.
description: Sharp hexagonal design, all-wheel drive and a 5.2-litre V10 that revs past 8,000 rpm. The Huracán EVO pairs drama with a predictive dynamics system that thinks a step ahead of the driver.

name: M4 Competition
tagline: Six cylinders, two doors, zero compromise.
description: M TwinPower Turbo inline-six, M xDrive all-wheel drive with a rear-biased 2WD mode, and a cockpit built around the curved display. A track-capable coupé that still does the daily commute.

modelCredit.title: 2026 BMW M4 Competition
modelCredit.author: Maroi Mister Let Me Think Official 3D Studio

name: AMG G 63
tagline: A military-grade silhouette with a hand-built V8.
description: Barely changed in shape since 1979, the G-Class is pure statement. The AMG G 63 adds a hand-built 4.0-litre biturbo V8 with mild-hybrid assist, three locking differentials and a cabin of quilted leather.

name: Range Rover
tagline: Reductive design. Unmatched composure.
description: The fifth-generation Range Rover strips the design back to a single clean volume with a floating roof and hidden lighting, hiding all-terrain ability under serene luxury. Locally assembled in India since 2024.

name: Model Y
tagline: The world's best-selling EV, now in India.
description: The refreshed Model Y brings a full-width light bar, a quieter cabin and ventilated seats. Launched in India in 2025 in Rear-Wheel Drive and Long Range RWD versions.

name: Thar ROXX
tagline: Five doors. Same unstoppable attitude.
description: The five-door Thar ROXX keeps the boxy, go-anywhere character of the original and adds space for the family, a panoramic sunroof, ADAS and a new 4XPLOR 4x4 system.

name: Fortuner
tagline: India's favourite full-size SUV.
description: A body-on-frame, seven-seat SUV famous for durability and resale value. The 2.8-litre diesel with 4x4 remains the enthusiast's pick, alongside the sportier GR-S and Legender variants.

name: Creta
tagline: The compact SUV that set the standard.
description: Hyundai's best-seller with a full-width LED light bar, a dual 10.25-inch display layout and three engines, including a 160 PS turbo petrol with a 7-speed DCT.

name: Nexon EV
tagline: India's electric SUV pioneer.
description: Tata's Nexon EV popularised electric cars in India. The 45 kWh version offers a claimed 489 km range, V2L and V2V charging, and a sharp split-headlamp design with connected LED bars.

name: Swift
tagline: The hatchback India grew up with.
description: The fourth-generation Swift brings a new 1.2-litre Z-series three-cylinder engine with class-leading efficiency, a sportier stance and a floating 9-inch touchscreen.

name: Sierra
tagline: The 90s icon, reborn with its wrap-around glasshouse.
description: Tata's revived Sierra keeps the original's upright stance and signature curved rear glass, now with a full-width LED light bar, a triple-screen dashboard and turbo-petrol and diesel engines.

name: Baleno
tagline: India's favourite premium hatchback.
description: The Baleno pairs a roomy cabin with a 1.2-litre DualJet petrol, a 9-inch touchscreen, a head-up display and 360-degree camera at a price that keeps it on every shortlist.

name: Glanza
tagline: Baleno underneath, Toyota badge and warranty on top.
description: Built by Maruti Suzuki for Toyota, the Glanza shares the Baleno's 1.2-litre K-series engine and cabin, with its own honeycomb grille and Toyota's longer standard warranty.

name: Dzire
tagline: India's best-selling sedan, now with a 5-star safety rating.
description: The fourth-generation Dzire gets its own sharper face, a sunroof, a 1.2-litre three-cylinder Z-series engine and a 5-star Global NCAP rating.

name: City
tagline: The benchmark mid-size sedan, now with a strong hybrid.
description: Honda's fifth-generation City is long, low and roomy, with a smooth 1.5-litre i-VTEC petrol and a self-charging e:HEV hybrid that returns over 27 kmpl.

name: Brezza
tagline: The sub-4-metre SUV that started a segment.
description: The Brezza keeps its boxy, upright stance with a 1.5-litre mild-hybrid petrol, an electric sunroof, a head-up display and a dual-tone floating-roof option.

name: Fronx
tagline: A coupe-style crossover on the Baleno's platform.
description: The Fronx blends a raised, clad body with a sloping roofline and offers a punchy 1.0-litre Boosterjet turbo-petrol alongside the 1.2-litre DualJet.

name: Ertiga
tagline: Seven seats, small-car running costs.
description: The Ertiga is India's go-to people carrier: three rows, a 1.5-litre mild-hybrid petrol or factory CNG, and a flat, practical cabin.

name: Innova Hycross
tagline: The Innova goes monocoque, and hybrid.
description: The Hycross trades the old ladder frame for a car-like platform with a 2.0-litre strong hybrid, captain seats with ottomans, and a panoramic sunroof.

name: Venue
tagline: Compact, connected and city-sized.
description: The Venue packs a choice of three engines, including a 1.0-litre turbo with a 7-speed DCT, and connected-car tech into a sub-4-metre SUV.

name: i20
tagline: The sharpest-looking premium hatch in its class.
description: The i20 combines a wide, low stance and Z-shaped tail-lamps with a 1.2-litre petrol, a Bose sound system and a sunroof.

name: Seltos
tagline: Tiger-nose style and a 160 PS turbo.
description: The Seltos brings a bold tiger-nose grille, star-map LED lighting, dual 10.25-inch screens, ADAS and a 160 PS 1.5-litre turbo-petrol to the mid-size SUV class.

name: Sonet
tagline: A grown-up feature list in a sub-4-metre SUV.
description: The Sonet offers ventilated seats, a Bose system and ADAS with petrol, turbo-petrol and diesel engines in a compact, upright body.

name: Punch
tagline: A micro-SUV with a 5-star safety rating.
description: The Punch packs SUV styling, 187 mm of ground clearance and a 5-star Global NCAP rating into a footprint shorter than most hatchbacks.

name: Harrier
tagline: Land Rover-derived bones, bold Indian design.
description: Built on the OMEGARC platform derived from Land Rover's D8, the Harrier pairs a 170 PS 2.0-litre diesel with split LED headlamps, a 12.3-inch screen and a 5-star Bharat NCAP rating.

name: XUV700
tagline: Big power, big screens, seven seats.
description: The XUV700 brings a 200 PS turbo-petrol or 185 PS diesel, ADAS, twin 10.25-inch screens, flush door handles and an optional AWD diesel.

name: Scorpio-N
tagline: The 'Big Daddy of SUVs', body-on-frame and tough.
description: The Scorpio-N keeps a rugged ladder-frame chassis with a 4XPLOR four-wheel-drive option, a 2.2-litre diesel and a commanding, upright stance.

name: Hector
tagline: The 'Internet Inside' SUV with a 14-inch screen.
description: The Hector's huge chrome-studded grille and portrait 14-inch touchscreen headline a roomy cabin with a panoramic sunroof and turbo-petrol or diesel power.

name: Wagon R
tagline: The tall-boy hatch India keeps coming back to.
description: The Wagon R's upright 'tall-boy' body gives it headroom and easy entry far beyond its size, with frugal 1.0 and 1.2-litre petrols and factory CNG.
